_about: Iteration log and LLM usage. Scores are against the answer key in the assignment sheet; points use the assignment weights (/70).

iterations.change: First evidence-extraction prompt plus deterministic policy rules.

iterations.step: Rule fix: event-based callback is vague
iterations.change: An acknowledged callback like 'next week after Dussehra' is vague (F12), so it falls back to call date + 3 days (F7). Next-call accuracy 97% → 100%.

Clarified: a family member needed only as companion is Travel; a cataract follow-up is Current Treatment; blocker quotes must be the customer's words; a routine location request is not an information request; 'Sunday' is not 'next Sunday'; added low-intent cues. Tested only on calls not used to write it (honest hold-out).

A booking needs the agent to confirm the slot; insurance or office checks are Cost; clinic reviewing reports is Treatment Concern; the final stated next step outranks earlier complaints; an accepted 'Should I call next week?' is a callback; 'not exactly pain' means the need is unclear.

If the customer's last turns say 'let you know', 'I'll think' etc. and no time was agreed, apply F7 (+3 days). Checked on all 50 gold labels: it never overrides a correct answer. No change on v1/v2 evidence.

A final vague answer cancels an earlier callback (F9); a month/day without a year rolls forward (F6); a booking must have a clock time or window (D3); High needs a proven 0–6 day offset (LQ). These are rare cases, so no score change on the 50 calls.
